elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate
elements.evidence: "Licensee may assign this Agreement and its rights hereunder, in whole or in part, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate"

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "or to a successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: "neither party may assign this Agreement ... without the other party's prior written consent"

elements.element: Consent standard: not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed"

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "Licensor may not in any event assign this Agreement to a competitor of Licensee"

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "shall not give Licensor any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise modify this Agreement"; automatic-termination sentence deleted

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: "neither party may assign ... without the other party's prior written consent" plus Licensee successor carve-out; "Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control promptly"

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed"

offending_extra_words: Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control promptly following its consummation

reasons: Preferred level is complete: Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent, mutual reasonable-consent standard, express bar on Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor, and removal of the change-of-control termination trigger.

Minimality fails: both operations are near whole-sentence rewrites (official gates: op 1 expands 28 words to 99, changed-character ratios 0.752 and 0.814 against a 0.600 limit) where a tighter carve-out plus deletion of the automatic-termination trigger would suffice.

Imported fallback-style notice duty on our own client ('Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control promptly following its consummation') adds an unnecessary Customer obligation not required at the preferred level.
Boilerplate expansions ('suspend, re-price or otherwise modify', 'conditioned or delayed', 'consolidation, reorganization', 'or equity') go beyond what the preferred position requires.
Intent preserved: the Change of Control definition, void-assignment sentence and successors/assigns language remain effective, with no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced.
